description.zh: 消费组ID，您可以调用[DescribeConsumerChannel](~~264169~~)接口查询消费组ID。
description.en: The ID of the consumer group. You can call [DescribeConsumerChannel](~~264169~~) to query the consumer group ID.

description.zh: 修改后的消费组名称，不超过128个字符。建议配置具有业务意义的名称，便于后续识别。
description.en: The new name of the consumer group. The name can be up to 128 characters in length. Specify a descriptive name for easy identification.

description.zh:
修改后的消费组账号密码。

- 由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意两种或两种以上组成。
- 密码长度为8~32个字符。
description.en:
The new password of the consumer group account.

- The password must contain characters from at least two of the following categories: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
- The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length.

description.zh:
修改后的消费组的账号。

- 由大写字母、小写字母、数字、下划线中的任意一种或多种组成。
- 最长16个字符。
description.en:
The new username of the consumer group account.

- The username can contain one or more types of the following characters: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).
- The username can be up to 16 characters in length.

description.zh:
订阅实例ID，可以调用[DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~)查询。
> 参数**DtsInstanceId**与**DtsJobId**，两者必须传入其一。
description.en:
The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to query the instance ID.
> You must specify either **DtsInstanceId** or **DtsJobId**.

description.zh:
订阅任务ID，可以调用[DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~)查询。
> 参数**DtsInstanceId**与**DtsJobId**，两者必须传入其一。
description.en:
The ID of the change tracking task. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to query the task ID.
> You must specify either **DtsInstanceId** or **DtsJobId**.

description.zh: DTS订阅实例所在地域的ID，请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region ID of the DTS change tracking instance. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

title.zh: 修改订阅通道中消费组
title.en: Modify a consumer group in a change tracking channel

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts modify-consumer-channel --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dts-instance-id dtsboss6pn1w730000 --dts-job-id boss6pn1w730000 --consumer-group-id dtsor2y66j42190000 --consumer-group-password Test123456 --consumer-group-user-name dtstest --consumer-group-name '订阅组B' --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts ModifyConsumerChannel --region cn-hangzhou --ConsumerGroupPassword Test123456 --DtsJobId boss6pn1w730000 --ConsumerGroupId dtsor2y66j42190000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --ConsumerGroupUserName dtstest --ConsumerGroupName '订阅组B' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DtsInstanceId dtsboss6pn1w730000
